system.description:
You are well versed in the hit-and-run tactics used by The Rebel Alliance and know how to use your mobility to avoid retribution.

Prerequisite: Running Attack

Effect: Whenever you use the Running Attack feat to move both before and after making an attack, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
